evidence.claim: Calls image transform, backbone, RPN, RoI heads, coordinate restoration and loss merge.
evidence.why: Establishes actual two-stage orchestration rather than an assumed architecture.

evidence.claim: Defines five pyramid anchor scales and three aspect ratios per location.
evidence.why: Documents shape priors and the number of RPN candidates.

evidence.claim: Builds RPN, 7x7 MultiScaleRoIAlign, TwoMLPHead, FastRCNNPredictor and default hyperparameters.
evidence.why: Pins the exact non-v2 variant and both suppression stages.

evidence.claim: Forms GT-anchor IoU matrix and labels positives, negatives and ignored anchors.
evidence.why: Shows many-to-one anchor matching in executable code.

evidence.claim: Thresholds each candidate's best GT IoU into foreground, background or ignore and invokes optional low-quality matching.
evidence.why: Explains how RPN avoids leaving poorly covered GT boxes without matched candidates.

evidence.claim: Uses sampled-anchor BCE and positive-only Smooth L1 with beta 1/9.
evidence.why: Distinguishes actual default losses from modern IoU loss recipes.

evidence.claim: Performs per-level top-K, clipping, small-box/score filtering and level-grouped NMS.
evidence.why: Distinguishes proposal filtering from final class-wise NMS.

evidence.claim: Appends GT proposals, matches, samples and encodes regression targets.
evidence.why: Shows second assignment stage and why weak RPNs can still provide training positives.

evidence.claim: Uses softmax CE and class-specific positive-only Smooth L1 normalized by sampled RoI count.
evidence.why: Makes the stage-two background and regression conventions explicit.

evidence.claim: Decodes class-specific boxes, softmaxes, removes background, thresholds and runs class-wise NMS.
evidence.why: Shows how many proposal-class candidates become final detections.

evidence.claim: Selects residual stages and builds a 256-channel BackboneWithFPN.
evidence.why: Identifies the actual neck and per-model feature selections.

evidence.claim: Upsamples top-down inner features and adds lateral features before output convolution.
evidence.why: Separates additive FPN fusion from concatenation-based PAN designs.

evidence.claim: Uses one stride-sized square reference per location and records inference defaults.
evidence.why: AnchorGenerator utility naming does not imply anchor-IoU-based assignment.

evidence.claim: Selects positives by center sampling, inside-box and scale bounds, breaking ties by smallest GT area.
evidence.why: Provides center-sampling assignment evidence and explains many-to-one positives.

evidence.claim: Uses sigmoid focal classification, decoded-box GIoU and positive centerness BCE, normalized by positives.
evidence.why: Documents the actual TorchVision loss recipe and its difference from generic FCOS summaries.

evidence.claim: Reshapes per-level dense class logits to N x HWA x C and concatenates levels.
evidence.why: Connects feature map locations to classifier targets and final candidate indexing.

evidence.claim: Applies ReLU to four regression outputs, predicts centerness from the regression tower, and flattens levels.
evidence.why: Establishes nonnegative distance prediction rather than anchor-delta regression.

evidence.claim: Encodes ltrb distances from reference centers and normalizes by reference width/height.
evidence.why: Explains the stride-sized references used by anchor-free FCOS.

evidence.claim: Computes square root of class-times-centerness sigmoid scores, per-level top-K, ltrb decoding and class-wise NMS.
evidence.why: Shows why FCOS uses NMS and why its confidence scale differs from softmax scores.

evidence.claim: Resizes prediction boxes from transformed image size to original image size.
evidence.why: Prevents confusing resized/padded coordinates with delivered detections.

evidence.claim: Builds ResNet50 FPN from layers 2,3,4 and P6/P7 extras.
evidence.why: Pins FCOS to P3-P7 rather than Faster R-CNN P2-P6.

evidence.claim: Creates Bottleneck ResNet with stage block counts 3,4,6,3.
evidence.why: Identifies real backbone implementation rather than only a model-family label.

evidence.claim: Weights BCE by alpha_t and (1-p_t)^gamma with defaults alpha .25 and gamma 2.
evidence.why: Explains dense negative downweighting rather than negative subsampling.

evidence.claim: Restores candidates having the maximum available overlap for each GT, including ties.
evidence.why: Provides the best-anchor rescue mechanism invoked by RPN matching.

evidence.claim: Multiplies normalized ltrb by reference dimensions then subtracts/adds distances around reference centers.
evidence.why: Recovers xyxy detections from FCOS point/stride references without anchor-shape regression.

evidence.claim: Backbone, top-down and bottom-up fusion, and three Detect input levels are explicitly wired in YAML.
evidence.why: Distinguishes the fusion neck from the Detect prediction module.

evidence.claim: Parser applies compound scaling, rounds channels, injects repeated-block counts and Detect input-channel list.
evidence.why: Unscaled YAML channels are not the actual YOLO11n tensor channels.

evidence.claim: C3k2 subclasses C2f and uses Bottleneck or C3k inner blocks.
evidence.why: Identifies actual backbone building block instead of assuming a ResNet backbone.

evidence.claim: Sequential stride-one max pooling and concatenation preserve feature resolution.
evidence.why: Explains receptive-field expansion at P5.

evidence.claim: Projection splits channels, applies PSABlock to one part, and fuses it with bypass.
evidence.why: Attention is part of the backbone feature processing.

evidence.claim: Standard Detect has end2end=False, reg_max=16, separated box/class branches and no objectness branch.
evidence.why: Defines both prediction representation and selected standard inference path.

evidence.claim: Flatten levels, integrate side distributions, decode around points, multiply by stride, and sigmoid class logits.
evidence.why: Connects dense raw predictions to resized-image boxes and class probabilities.

evidence.claim: Fixed weights 0 through 15 calculate expected side distances after softmax.
evidence.why: Distributional regression must be decoded before box geometry is available.

evidence.claim: Non-end-to-end YOLO11 uses v8DetectionLoss.
evidence.why: Shared code names can describe newer model configurations without a separate loss class.

evidence.claim: BCE classification; call-site TaskAligned topk10 alpha0.5 beta6; detached predictions for assignment; CIoU and DFL weighted losses.
evidence.why: Prevents mistaking commented varifocal code or unrelated focal classes for the active objective.

evidence.claim: Inside-box candidate masks and top-k alignment use s^alpha times clamped CIoU^beta.
evidence.why: Assignment uses both classification confidence and predicted geometry, rather than fixed anchor-box IoU.

evidence.claim: Resolve collisions and normalize alignment scores to soft target scores.
evidence.why: Shows why classification labels carry localization quality.

evidence.claim: When one point is assigned to multiple targets, keep the highest-overlap target.
evidence.why: Distinguishes conflict resolution from one-to-one set matching.

evidence.claim: Two-bin interpolated cross entropy supervises continuous side-distance targets.
evidence.why: DFL is a box-regression loss, not the classification focal loss.

evidence.claim: Generate center points with offset 0.5 and associate strides; no predefined aspect-ratio boxes.
evidence.why: Internal anchors naming does not make the detector anchor-box-based.

evidence.claim: Invoke confidence/IoU-configured NMS then scale boxes into the original image frame.
evidence.why: Traces the model-to-final-detections path.

evidence.claim: Confidence filter, xywh-to-xyxy conversion, optional class selection, pre-NMS truncation, class offsets, torchvision NMS and max_det.
evidence.why: Standard YOLO11 uses class-aware NMS rather than one-to-one query selection.

evidence.claim: Subtract letterbox padding, divide by gain, and clip to original image dimensions.
evidence.why: Coordinates must be restored before comparing with original annotations.

evidence.claim: BGR-to-RGB conversion, BCHW reordering and /255 normalization follow the pre_transform call.
evidence.why: Makes the preprocessing and box-restoration pair explicit.

evidence.claim: Quality-weighted CIoU and DFL supervise decoded boxes and side-distance distributions.
evidence.why: DFL is a box-regression loss, not the classification focal loss.

evidence.claim: Decode four ltrb distances into box coordinates relative to grid points.
evidence.why: Internal anchors naming does not make the detector anchor-box-based.

evidence.claim: LetterBox resizes images while preserving aspect ratio and adding padding.
evidence.why: Makes the preprocessing and box-restoration pair explicit.

evidence.claim: Detection mode returns only ResNet layer4; segmentation may request intermediate layers.
evidence.why: Original DETR is single-scale and has no FPN/PAN.

evidence.claim: ResNet uses FrozenBatchNorm2d; ResNet-50 emits 2048 channels.
evidence.why: Identifies actual backbone rather than assigning a generic transformer-only backbone.

evidence.claim: Creates class linear head, three-layer box MLP, learned object-query embedding and 1x1 feature projection.
evidence.why: Connects queries and output heads to concrete modules.

evidence.claim: Uses features[-1], transformer outputs, class head and sigmoid normalized box head.
evidence.why: Traces the actual final detection computation.

evidence.claim: Flattens spatial features, repeats learned query embeddings and initializes zero decoder content.
evidence.why: Explains how image features and object slots enter attention.

evidence.claim: Runs query self-attention followed by cross-attention over encoder memory.
evidence.why: Query interaction is part of joint set prediction.

evidence.claim: Combines negative class probability, pairwise L1 and negative GIoU, then invokes SciPy linear_sum_assignment.
evidence.why: One-to-one global assignment differs from dense many-positive training; matching cost is not cross entropy.

evidence.claim: Initializes every query to no-object, overwrites matched labels, and applies weighted cross entropy.
evidence.why: Unmatched duplicates receive no-object supervision.

evidence.claim: Computes matched-box L1 and 1-GIoU normalized by object count.
evidence.why: Distinguishes differentiable box loss from matching cost.

evidence.claim: Normalizes object count across workers and rematches every auxiliary decoder output.
evidence.why: Intermediate supervision does not reuse the final decoder assignment.

evidence.claim: Softmaxes logits, chooses foreground class per query, converts cxcywh to xyxy, and scales by target dimensions; no NMS, cutoff or top-K.
evidence.why: Verifies exact NMS-free inference and original-coordinate recovery.

evidence.claim: Passes each target orig_size to bbox postprocessor.
evidence.why: Confirms the rescaling dimensions are original image dimensions during evaluation.

evidence.claim: CLI defaults are ResNet-50, sine encoding, 6+6 transformer layers, 256 dimensions, 8 heads, 100 queries, matching/loss coefficients 1:5:2 and eos_coef=0.1.
evidence.why: Actual build defaults override generic constructor defaults.

evidence.claim: COCO uses max category id plus one (91), so the classifier adds no-object for 92 outputs.
evidence.why: Avoids incorrectly reporting this original repository as an 81-logit contiguous COCO classifier.

evidence.claim: Unpacks cx,cy,w,h and constructs corner coordinates.
evidence.why: Actual box representation resolves a width/height typo in DETR.forward docstring.

evidence.claim: Applies criterion.weight_dict to returned component losses.
evidence.why: Loss coefficients are applied outside SetCriterion.loss_boxes; cardinality logging is not optimized.
